screen.title: Announcement: Midterm change
screen.prompt: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.

audio.text: Before you leave, a quick reminder about next week. Because of the holiday on Monday, our midterm exam will move to Wednesday, same time and room. The exam will cover chapters one through six, but not the guest lecture we had last week. You may bring one page of handwritten notes. If you have a conflict with another exam on Wednesday, email me by Friday.

questions.stem: Why is the exam being moved?
options: Students asked for more time to study.
The room is needed for a guest lecture.
The original date falls on a holiday.
The professor will be away on Monday.

questions.stem: What are students allowed to bring to the exam?
options: A printed copy of the lecture slides
Their textbooks for chapters one to six
Their notes from the guest lecture
A sheet of notes written by hand

why.en: Detail (paraphrase): one page of handwritten notes.
why.tr: Detay (parafraz): one page of handwritten notes.
why.es: Detalle (paráfrasis): una página de apuntes escritos a mano.
